name: r8-e1-fused-emb-persist
author: solx-loop
description: The FP16 tc_h path (B > 256) carried 3-5.4 us per call in its separate fp16 emb pre-pass and the launch gap that follows it, and nb2 (691-919) also paid a second wave's CTA start, prologue and first-k-block fill. Here each of the 144 CTAs bulk-copies its 1/144 slice of fp32 emb into the still-empty stage area. Warps 0-3 convert the slice to the fp16 scratch and release a grid-wide counter. The emb TMA producer acquires the counter before its first load, so the conversion is hidden behind the ~5
